description: Execute a quote from wallet_swap_quote by its swap_quote_id (must run before the quote expires). MOVES MONEY: validates the swap PSET pays your own receive address, signs, and lets SideSwap broadcast. Passes the SENT side through the owner's value guardrails BEFORE signing (market swaps are allowlist-exempt — funds return to your wallet). Irreversible once broadcast.

swap_quote_id.description: The swap_quote_id returned by wallet_swap_quote. Single-use; execute before it expires.

name: wallet_swap_execute

brl_cents.description: The SENT side valued in BRL cents — what was counted against the guardrail (§4.3).

post_sync_failed.description: true when the balance refresh (sync) AFTER this money-moving call failed. The money already moved (see the txid); the next balance read reflects it. This is never a failure of the operation itself.

send_amount_sats.description: Base units of `from` that left the wallet.

stale.description: true when the balance refresh (sync) before this read/spend FAILED and the result reflects the last persisted snapshot — the on-chain state may be newer. Reads never fail on a provider outage; they serve the snapshot with this flag. Absent means the state was refreshed.

txid.description: The broadcast Liquid swap transaction id.

title: Execute a SideSwap quote
